steps.caption: Calendar, queue & history
steps.narration: Calendar, queue and history is where every post and photo of the listing is tracked.

steps.caption: Queue
steps.narration: Queue lists the items newest first.

steps.caption: Kind, time, status
steps.narration: Each item shows its kind, its time and its status, with a Cancel button while it is queued.

steps.caption: Calendar
steps.narration: Choose Calendar, and the same items are grouped under the day they are due.

steps.caption: A heading per day
steps.narration: Each day is a heading, with the items due that day listed under it.

steps.caption: History
steps.narration: The past is history: a published post also shows Google's own status, LIVE.

steps.caption: Refresh Google status
steps.narration: Refresh Google status asks Google again about the published posts.

steps.caption: The queued items
steps.narration: Further down come the items still waiting, in the order they are due.

steps.caption: Cancel
steps.narration: Cancel takes a queued item out of the queue.

steps.caption: Marked cancelled
steps.narration: It stays in the list, marked cancelled, so the record is complete.

steps.caption: Google Business → Posts & Photos
steps.narration: You'll find Posts and Photos in the Google Business rail on the left.

youtube.title: Track every Google post: calendar, queue and history | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How Calendar, queue & history works in Posts & Photos in ConstructHUB: the queue newest first, the calendar by day, published items with Google's own status, Refresh Google status, and Cancel on anything still queued.
